annotations.title: Write a video with the AI director

description: Write a short vertical video with the iDos Games video studio's AI director: an idea becomes a VideoSpec (format, scene, characters, lines with emotions and actions, captions) built from the studio library, plus the plan — for each element whether the library fits or an AI asset should be generated (`next` lists the generate_asset calls: pass them the returned `package` and the item's slot, and the asset takes its place). Refs outside the library are replaced with the closest library asset (listed in `repaired`), the cast is fitted to the format. Costs one text generation of the publisher's credits (see estimate_media_cost, modality text). If it is not ready in about two minutes the answer carries the generation id — call plan_video again with generation_id to finish it without paying twice. The answer is a video PACKAGE ({ spec, assets }) and, when title_id names a game with the video studio, a `link` that opens it in that app's editor — the player watches, edits and exports the MP4 on the device (there is no server render). Formats and assets: list_video_formats, search_assets.

cast.description: How many characters (optional — the format decides).

format.description: Format id from list_video_formats, e.g. dialogue@1, story@1, top5@1, quiz@1, whatif@1.

generation_id.description: Finish a plan whose generation was still running (optional; no new charge).

idea.description: What the video is about, in any language (≤ 600 characters).

language.description: Language of the lines in words, e.g. English or Russian (default English).

mode.description: unique (default) — the plan may ask for AI assets; quick — library only, AI items dropped.

style.description: Style family of the studio library, e.g. voxel-warm or chibi-2d (default voxel-warm).

title_id.description: Which game this is for — a label for the report, optional (credits are the publisher's).
